input.question: Who is the artist of the album "Both Sides Now"?

documents.text: Both Sides Now (Willie Nelson album) Both Sides Now is the tenth studio album by country singer Willie Nelson, released in 1970. With the dawn of the new decade, Nelson had not achieved the commercial success at RCA that he had hoped for. He gained a measure of fame writing songs that were hits for Faron Young (“Hello Walls”), Billy Walker ("Funny How Time Slips Away”), Patsy Cline (“Crazy”), and Roy Orbison (“Pretty Paper"), but most of his singles stalled on the charts, his biggest single at RCA being the Vegas-styled cover “Bring Me Sunshine,” which hit number 13.
